propositions: A completion verify run with a banked operator-actionable BLOCK that encounters a provider outage should finalize a deterministic FAIL verdict from the bank with no additional LLM calls, surfacing the banked refutation for operator decision.
An empty criterion bank or a bank holding only PASS/insufficiency entries during an LLM outage should preserve the retryable exit-11 posture per ADR 0040, re-raising the outage unchanged.
The degrade verdict is certifiable=False and does not auto-close the subject ticket; it flows to close_precheck's non-close branch (returncode 1) requiring operator intervention.
The degrade path is guarded so any fault (bank read error, unreadable ticket) falls through to re-raise the outage unchanged, never creating a new failure mode.

CompletionAgentStep.run's except LLMUnavailableError arm invokes _degrade_from_actionable_bank after stamping the retryable disposition, checking bank_has_actionable_block(met=False AND not insufficiency) to decide between degrade-and-return or re-raise.
